2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch separates the processing of PTE-batch folios into a new helper function, madvise_lru_pte_batch_locked(). This function takes care of locking and referencing a split candidate folio before returning it to the caller. The original code combined page-table iteration with validation and processing in a single loop, which made it difficult to understand the batching rules for large folios and the ownership transferred when a partial folio is split. By moving this logic into a separate function, the patch improves the clarity and maintainability of the code without introducing any functional changes.
